verification.summary: Passed 3/3 in 2.5 minutes with one worker and zero retries, on approval 2026-08-20-multi-currency-closure. M1 USD, M2 EUR conversion and M3 immutability all green. Re-run deliberately rather than citing the 2026-08-13 result: that evidence predates changes to the redirect drivers, the gateway availability logic and the shared provider-evidence module, and closing a row on a week-old narrative is the failure mode this programme exists to avoid. M2 asserts the fee and net at parity with the WooPayments client rather than against the balance transaction, and carries a tripwire that fires when TRAPLAT-4144 is fixed. Lock directory ended with zero quarantine receipts and zero unresolved provider write attempts.
